title: Health Equals Quality
description: This mod adds a thing, that when your health gets lower, the quality goes lower too!
body:
# **Release**

Hello there, this mod adds a function, when you're low on health, your quality goes down.

The quality is more Pixelated, blured.

Imagine just going to cave and taking damage, BOOM, your quality goes so low.. That you cannot see ANYTHING!

really cool and scary tho :P

I'm really happy how it works, and hope you like it too!

Have a great time spending playing with this mod!
